result.title: Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators
result.summary: Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. The indirect effect requires the sensitivity of the converged policy to the design, which we obtain by applying the implicit function theorem to the stationarity condition of the policy gradient. Based on this sensitivity, we develop a proof-of-concept co-design algorithm with stochastic value gradient (SVG)-style policy optimization, prove that it converges to an approximately stationary design, and demonstrate on a differentiable networked-system benchmark with high-dimensional design spaces that it consistently outperforms BO and ES.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出基于梯度的系统—策略协同设计方法：把设计梯度拆为固定策略下的直接效应与经由最优策略的间接效应，并用隐函数定理从策略梯度平稳条件得到策略对设计的敏感度，在可微网络系统基准上显示优于 BO 与 ES。
AI.relevance_reason: 不研究 VLM 推理；其对收敛量做隐函数微分、在双层优化中回传梯度的思路，可能为迭代式 latent 推理（如循环精化至定点）的训练监督与贡献分配提供可供核查的技术线索。
